claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars will air live on ABC and stream on Hulu on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
The 2026 Oscars are also available via live TV streaming services carrying ABC, such as YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, FuboTV, and DIRECTV.
